description: PingAM realm monitoring dashboard — Authentication, Sessions, and OAuth2/OIDC metrics from Prometheus, plus audit log analysis from Elasticsearch. Importable via Grafana → Dashboards → Import.

panels.description: Rate of all authentication requests (success + failure) per minute.
panels.title: Auth Requests / min

panels.description: Percentage of authentication attempts that succeeded.
panels.title: Auth Success Rate %

panels.description: Rate of new sessions being created per minute. PingAM does not expose an active-session gauge via Prometheus; use am_session_count{operation='create'} as a proxy for session load.
panels.title: New Sessions / min

panels.description: Rate of OAuth2 access tokens granted per minute across all grant types.
panels.title: OAuth2 Tokens / min

panels.description: Rate of authentication requests split by outcome. Source: am_authentication_count (Summary metric with outcome label).
panels.title: Authentication Requests by Outcome

panels.description: Current authentication success rate percentage.
panels.title: Auth Success Rate

panels.description: Authentication response time quantiles from the am_authentication Summary metric. P50 = median, P95 = 95th percentile, P99 = 99th percentile.
panels.title: Authentication Latency (Quantiles)

panels.description: Execution rate per authentication tree node type. Useful for identifying hot nodes or bottlenecks in journey flows.
panels.title: Auth Tree Node Execution Rate

panels.description: Rate of session create and destroy operations. PingAM does not expose an active-session count gauge via Prometheus; this chart shows throughput via am_session_count{operation=...}.
panels.title: Session Operation Rates

panels.description: Session operation rates from am_session_count. Confirmed operation label values: create, check-exists, add-pll-listener, destroy. Values for 'timeout' and 'rejected' may differ in your deployment — run `curl .../metrics/prometheus | grep am_session_count` to see exact operation values.
panels.title: Session Lifecycle Rate

panels.description: Rate of OAuth2 grants completed by grant type. Source: am_oauth2_grant_count with grant_type label (authorization_code, client_credentials, refresh_token, urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:device_code, etc.).
panels.title: Token Grants by Grant Type

panels.description: OAuth2 access tokens issued in the selected time window (am_oauth2_token_issue_count{token_type='access_token'}). Note: PingAM does not expose a live active-token count via Prometheus.
panels.title: Access Tokens Issued

panels.description: OAuth2 refresh tokens issued in the selected time window (am_oauth2_token_issue_count{token_type='refresh_token'}).
panels.title: Refresh Tokens Issued

panels.description: Share of OAuth2 token grants by grant type over the selected time window.
panels.title: Grant Type Distribution

panels.description: Rate of token and grant revocations. am_oauth2_token_revoke_count and am_oauth2_grant_revoke_count are confirmed metrics. am_oauth2_introspect_count is unconfirmed — remove if it returns no data.
panels.title: Token Revocation & Grant Revocation Rate

panels.description: Rate of Core Token Service (CTS) operations by type. CTS stores AM sessions, OAuth2 tokens, and SAML assertions. High create/delete rates correlate with session and token activity.
panels.title: CTS Task Rate by Operation

panels.description: Number of CTS operations currently waiting in the task queue (am_cts_task_queue_size). This is a live gauge — elevated values indicate CTS backpressure or LDAP store latency.
panels.title: CTS Queue Depth

panels.description: Rate of authorization policy evaluations by policy set type (am_authorization_policy_set_evaluate_count). Spikes may indicate heavy PEP load or misconfigured resource servers.
panels.title: Policy Evaluation Rate by Policy Set

panels.description: Live stream of PingAM authentication audit events from Elasticsearch. Filter by outcome=FAILED in Grafana Explore for failure analysis.
panels.title: Recent Authentication Events

panels.description: Volume of audit events per component (AUTHENTICATION, OAUTH2, SESSION, ACCESS) over time.

targets.query: realm:"$realm" AND (component:AUTHENTICATION OR component:OAUTH2 OR component:SESSION OR component:ACCESS)

panels.title: Audit Event Volume by Component & Result

panels.description: Top failing principals in the selected time range. Helps identify brute-force or misconfigured accounts.
panels.title: Auth Failure Breakdown (by principal)

panels.description: OAuth2 audit event distribution — token issuance, revocation, introspection, etc.
panels.title: OAuth2 Audit Events (by eventName)

panels.description: Session audit events — creation, destruction, timeout.
panels.title: Session Audit Events (by eventName)

options.content:
## 📖 About This Dashboard

**Data sources**
| Source | Covers | Endpoint |
|--------|--------|----------|
| Prometheus | Auth, Sessions, OAuth2, CTS, Policy | `/openam/json/metrics/prometheus` (AM 6/7) · `/metrics/prometheus` (AM 8+) |
| Elasticsearch | Audit log events | Your PingAM audit index (`timestamp` field) |

---

### ✅ Confirmed Prometheus Metric Names (PingAM 8 / PingOne Advanced Identity Cloud)

| Metric | Label | Values | Description |
|--------|-------|--------|-------------|
| `am_authentication_count` | `outcome` | `success`, `failure`, `timeout` | Auth attempts |
| `am_authentication` | `quantile` | 0.5, 0.75, 0.95, 0.99 | Auth latency (Summary) |
| `am_session_count` | `operation` | `create`, `check-exists`, `destroy`, `add-pll-listener` | Session ops |
| `am_session_seconds` | `operation`, `quantile` | — | Session op latency |
| `am_cts_task_count` | `operation` | `create`, `read`, `delete`, … | CTS task ops |
| `am_cts_task_queue_size` | — | — | **Gauge**: CTS queue backlog |
| `am_cts_task_seconds` | `operation`, `quantile` | — | CTS task latency |
| `am_oauth2_grant_count` | `grant_type` | authorization_code, client_credentials, refresh_token, … | Grant completions |
| `am_oauth2_grant_revoke_count` | `grant_type` | — | Grant revocations |
| `am_oauth2_token_issue_count` | `token_type` | `access_token`, `refresh_token`, `id_token` | Token issuances |
| `am_oauth2_token_revoke_count` | `token_type` | — | Token revocations |
| `am_authorization_policy_set_evaluate_count` | `policy_type` | — | Policy eval calls |

> **Active session count**: PingAM does not expose an active-session gauge via Prometheus.
> This dashboard uses `am_session_count{operation="create"}` as a throughput proxy.

---

### ⚠️ Unconfirmed Metrics (verify against your scrape output)

| Metric | Used in | Notes |
|--------|---------|-------|
| `am_trees_nodeExecution_count` | Auth Tree Node panel | May not exist; remove if no data |
| `am_oauth2_introspect_count` | Revocation panel | Not in official docs; remove if no data |

Run this to see exactly what your PingAM exposes:
```bash
curl -s https://<am-host>/openam/json/metrics/prometheus | grep '^am_' | sort -u
```

---

### 🗂️ Elasticsearch Audit Fields

| Field | Example | Notes |
|-------|---------|-------|
| `timestamp` | `2026-08-11T10:00:00Z` | Time field (not @timestamp) |
| `component` | `AUTHENTICATION`, `OAUTH2`, `SESSION`, `ACCESS` | Audit category |
| `eventName` | `AM-AUTH-LOGIN-COMPLETED` | Event identifier |
| `realm` | `/alpha` | Realm path |
| `result` | `SUCCESSFUL`, `FAILED` | Outcome |
| `principal` | `user@example.com` | Acting principal |
